name: Regression-based FisherRF
definition: A variant of FisherRF that replaces direct variance-to-pixel mapping with a meta-regression model, using grouped Gaussian parameter variances as input feature maps to predict pixel-wise uncertainty.
summary: Regression-based FisherRF estimates rendering uncertainty by using a meta-regression model to predict pixel-wise values from grouped Gaussian parameter variances, differing from the original method by aligning with PRIMU's feature map approach.
